noun_definition: Profile pic refers to the image that represents a user in the application, which is expected to update in the tooltip when the user hovers over their email, but does not do so in offline mode.
Tooltip refers to the user interface element that displays user details when hovering over an email in the chat, which is expected to show the updated profile picture.
offline mode refers to the state in which the application is not connected to the internet, affecting the ability to update and display the profile picture in tooltips.
